mapper.select:
select count(*) from `card` where `coupon_allocate_id` in
#{item}

SELECT cci.id as couponId, CASE WHEN cci.type = 0 THEN vc.useable_clinci WHEN cci.type = 1 THEN dc.useable_clinic WHEN cci.type = 2 THEN pc.useable_clinic WHEN cci.type = 3 THEN spc.useable_clinic END as useableClinic, CASE WHEN cci.type = 0 THEN vc.limit_count WHEN cci.type = 1 THEN 1 WHEN cci.type = 2 THEN pc.limit_count WHEN cci.type = 3 THEN spc.limit_count END as limitCount, CASE WHEN cci.type = 0 THEN vc.mixed_use_type WHEN cci.type = 1 THEN dc.mixable WHEN cci.type = 2 THEN pc.mixable WHEN cci.type = 3 THEN spc.mixable END as mixable, CASE WHEN cci.type = 0 THEN 0 WHEN cci.type = 1 THEN 0 WHEN cci.type = 2 THEN pc.use_way WHEN cci.type = 3 THEN spc.use_way END as useWay FROM coupon_common_info cci LEFT JOIN package_coupon pc on pc.coupon_id = cci.id LEFT JOIN special_package_coupon spc on spc.coupon_id = cci.id LEFT JOIN vouche_coupon vc on vc.coupon_id = cci.id LEFT JOIN discount_coupon dc on dc.coupon_id = cci.id WHERE cci.id = #{couponId}

SELECT cd.id as cardId, cd.coupon_id as couponId, cci.name as couponName, cci.type as couponType, CASE WHEN cci.type = 0 THEN if(vc.effective_days = 0,null,date_add(date_format(cd.active_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL vc.effective_days DAY)) WHEN cci.type = 1 THEN if(dc.effective_days = 0,null,date_add(date_format(cd.active_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL dc.effective_days DAY)) WHEN cci.type = 2 THEN if(pc.effective_days = 0,null,date_add(date_format(cd.active_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL pc.effective_days DAY)) WHEN cci.type = 3 THEN if(spc.effective_days = 0,null,date_add(date_format(cd.active_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL spc.effective_days DAY)) END as activationDeadline, cfi.file_name as fileName, cfi.path FROM card cd LEFT JOIN coupon_common_info cci on cd.coupon_id = cci.id LEFT JOIN package_coupon pc on pc.coupon_id = cci.id LEFT JOIN special_package_coupon spc on spc.coupon_id = cci.id LEFT JOIN vouche_coupon vc on vc.coupon_id = cci.id LEFT JOIN discount_coupon dc on dc.coupon_id = cci.id LEFT JOIN coupon_file_info cfi on cfi.coupon_id = cci.id and cfi.file_type = 0 WHERE cd.patient_id = #{patientId} and cd.status in (2,3) and cci.type in(0,1,2,3) and cci.is_inservice = 1 GROUP BY cd.id
select count(`coupon_id`) from `card` where `coupon_id` = #{couponId} and `org_id` != 0 and isnull(`org_id`) = 0

select `cci`.id as `couponId`, `cci`.name as `couponName`, `cci`.`type` as `couponType`, if(ISNULL(`cci`.`available_sale_end_date`), '不限售出时间', concat_ws(' - ', date_format(`cci`.`available_sale_start_date`, '%Y/%m/%d'), date_format(`cci`.`available_sale_end_date`, '%Y/%m/%d'))) as `saleSegment`, `cci`.`sold_amount` as `soldAmount`, sum(`ca`.`allocate_num`) as `allocateNum`, (select sum(`c`.`status` in (1, 2, 3, 4)) from `card` `c` where `c`.`coupon_id` = `ca`.`coupon_id` and `c`.`org_id` = `ca`.`org_id` group by `c`.`coupon_id`, `c`.`org_id`) as `soldNum`, `ca`.`org_id` as `orgId` from `coupon_common_info` `cci` inner join `coupon_allocate` `ca` on `cci`.`id` = `ca`.`coupon_id` where `ca`.`org_id` = #{orgId} and `cci`.`is_inservice` = 1 and isnull(`ca`.`allocate_user_id`) = 0 and isnull(`ca`.`allocate_date`) = 0
and `cci`.`name` like concat('%', #{couponName}, '%')
and `cci`.`type` in
#{item}
group by `ca`.`coupon_id`, `ca`.`org_id` order by `ca`.`crt_time` desc

select `c`.`id`, `c`.`card_number`, `c`.`sold_target`, `c`.`sold_phone_number`, `cci`.`sold_amount` as `paidAmount`, case when `c`.`sold_type` = 0 then '售卖' when `c`.`sold_type` = 1 then '置换' when `c`.`sold_type` = 2 then '赠送' else null end as `soldTypeName`, case when `c`.`is_sold_and_pay` = 0 then 1 else 0 end as `charge`, case when `c`.`is_sold_and_pay` = 0 then `cci`.`sold_amount` else 0 end as `soldAmount`, case when `cci`.`type` = 4 then (select `bonus` from `recharge_card` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) else null end as `bonus` from `card` `c` inner join `coupon_common_info` `cci` on `c`.`coupon_id` = `cci`.`id` where `c`.`card_number` = #{cardNumber} and `c`.`card_password` = #{cardPassword}

select `temp`.`cardId`, `temp`.`couponId`, `temp`.`card_number`, `temp`.`ownerId`, `temp`.`couponName`, `temp`.`couponType`, ifnull(`temp`.`useDeadline`, '永久有效') as `useDeadline`, `temp`.`useWay`, `temp`.`mixable`, `temp`.`path`, `temp`.`limitCount`, `temp`.`soldDate` from (select `c`.`id` as `cardId`, if(`c`.`org_id` = 0, `c`.`third_card_number`, `c`.`card_number`) as `card_number`, `c`.`patient_id` as `ownerId`, `cci`.id as `couponId`, `cci`.`name` as `couponName`, `cci`.`type` as `couponType`, `c`.`sold_date` as `soldDate`, case when `cci`.`type` = 0 then (select `mixed_use_type` from `vouche_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 1 then (select `mixable` from `discount_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 2 then (select `mixable` from `package_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 3 then (select `mixable` from `special_package_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 5 then (select `mixable` from `deduction_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) else null end as `mixable`, case when `cci`.`type` = 2 then (select `use_way` from `package_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 3 then (select `use_way` from `special_package_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 5 then (select `use_way` from `deduction_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) else null end as `useWay`, case when `cci`.`type` = 0 then (select if(isnull(activation_deadline), if(`effective_days` = 0, null, date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval `effective_days` day), '%Y-%m-%d')), if(activation_deadline < date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'), activation_deadline, date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'))) from `vouche_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.coupon_id) when `cci`.`type` = 1 then (select if(isnull(activation_deadline), if(`effective_days` = 0, null, date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval `effective_days` day), '%Y-%m-%d')), if(activation_deadline < date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'), activation_deadline, date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'))) from `discount_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 2 then (select if(isnull(activation_deadline), if(`effective_days` = 0, null, date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval `effective_days` day), '%Y-%m-%d')), if(activation_deadline < date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'), activation_deadline, date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'))) from `package_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 3 then (select if(isnull(activation_deadline), if(`effective_days` = 0, null, date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval `effective_days` day), '%Y-%m-%d')), if(activation_deadline < date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'), activation_deadline, date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'))) from `special_package_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 5 then (select if(isnull(activation_deadline), if(`effective_days` = 0, null, date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval `effective_days` day), '%Y-%m-%d')), if(activation_deadline < date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'), activation_deadline, date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'))) from `deduction_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) else null end as `useDeadline`, case when `cci`.`type` in (0, 1) then (select if(count(*) = 0, 1, 0) from `card_benefit` `bd` where `bd`.`card_id` = `c`.`id` and `bd`.`benefit_type` = 1 and `bd`.`is_deleted` = 0) when `cci`.`type` = 2 then (select if(count(`bd`.`card_id`) = 0, null, count(`bd`.`card_id`) < (select sum(count) from `package_coupon_item` `pci` where `pci`.`coupon_id` = `cci`.`id` group by `pci`.`coupon_id`) ) from `card_benefit` `bd` where `bd`.`card_id` = `c`.`id` and `bd`.`benefit_type` = 1 and `bd`.`is_deleted` = 0) when `cci`.`type` = 3 then (select if(count(`bd`.`card_id`) = 0, null, count(`bd`.`card_id`) < (select sum(count) from `special_package_coupon_item` `spci` where `spci`.`coupon_id` = `cci`.`id` group by `spci`.`coupon_id`) ) from `card_benefit` `bd` where `bd`.`card_id` = `c`.`id` and `bd`.`benefit_type` = 1 and `bd`.`is_deleted` = 0) when `cci`.`type` = 5 then (select if(count(`bd`.`card_id`) = 0, null, count(`bd`.`card_id`) < (select sum(count) from `deduction_item_period` `dip` where `dip`.`coupon_id` = `cci`.`id` and crt_time = (select max(crt_time) from deduction_item_period where `coupon_id` = `cci`.`id` and crt_time <=( select crt_time from coupon_order_virtual where card_id = `c`.`id` and inservice = 1 )) group by `dip`.`coupon_id`) ) from `card_benefit` `bd` where `bd`.`card_id` = `c`.`id` and `bd`.`benefit_type` = 1 and `bd`.`is_deleted` = 0) else null end as `itemUseable`, (select `cfi`.`path` from `coupon_file_info` `cfi` where `cfi`.`coupon_id` = `cci`.`id` and `cfi`.`inservice` = 1 and `cfi`.`file_type` = 0 ORDER BY `cfi`.`crt_time` asc LIMIT 1) as `path`, case when `cci`.`type` = 0 then (select count(*) from `vouche_coupon` `vc` where `vc`.`coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id` and find_in_set(#{orgId}, `vc`.`useable_clinci`)) when `cci`.`type` = 1 then (select count(*) from `discount_coupon` `dc` where `dc`.`coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id` and find_in_set(#{orgId}, `dc`.`useable_clinic`)) when `cci`.`type` = 2 then (select count(*) from `package_coupon` `pc` where `pc`.`coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id` and find_in_set(#{orgId}, `pc`.`useable_clinic`)) when `cci`.`type` = 3 then (select count(*) from `special_package_coupon` `spc` where `spc`.`coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id` and find_in_set(#{orgId}, `spc`.`useable_clinic`)) when `cci`.`type` = 5 then (select count(*) from `deduction_coupon` `dc` where `dc`.`coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id` and find_in_set(#{orgId}, `dc`.`useable_clinic`)) else null end as `useClinicCount`, case when `cci`.`type` = 0 then (select `limit_count` from `vouche_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 1 then 1 when `cci`.`type` = 2 then (select `limit_count` from `package_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 3 then (select `limit_count` from `special_package_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) else null end as `limitCount` from `card` `c` inner join `coupon_common_info` `cci` on `c`.`coupon_id` = `cci`.`id` where `cci`.`is_inservice` = 1 and `c`.`status` in (2,3) and `cci`.`type` != 4 and (`c`.`patient_id` = #{patientId} or (find_in_set(#{patientId}, `c`.`sharer`)))) `temp` where (isnull(`temp`.`useWay`) = 1 and `temp`.`itemUseable` = 1 or (`temp`.`useWay` = 0 and isnull(`temp`.`itemUseable`) = 1 or (`temp`.`useWay` = 1 and (`temp`.`itemUseable` = 1 or isnull(`temp`.`itemUseable`) = 1)))) and `temp`.`useClinicCount` > 0 and (isnull(`temp`.`useDeadline`) = 1 or `temp`.`useDeadline` >= date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-%d'))

select cci.id as couponid, cci.name as couponname, case when cci.type = 0 then ( select vc.limit_count from vouche_coupon vc where vc.coupon_id = cci.id ) when cci.type = 2 then ( select pc.limit_count from package_coupon pc where pc.coupon_id = cci.id ) when cci.type = 3 then ( select spc.limit_count from special_package_coupon spc where spc.coupon_id = cci.id ) when cci.type = 5 then ( select dc.limit_count from deduction_coupon dc where dc.coupon_id = cci.id ) else null end as limitcount from coupon_common_info cci where cci.id = #{couponId} and cci.is_inservice = 1;

select `temp`.`cardId` as `cardId`, `temp`.`couponId` as `couponId`, `temp`.`name` as couponName, `temp`.`couponType` as `couponType`, `temp`.`file_type` as fileType, `temp`.`path`, if(isnull(`temp`.`useDeadline`), '永久有效', concat_ws(' - ', `temp`.`activeDate`, `temp`.`useDeadline`)) as `effectiveDate`, `temp`.`cardNumber` from ( select `c`.`id` as `cardId`, ifnull(c.card_number, c.third_card_number) as cardNumber, `cci`.`id` as `couponId`, `cci`.`name`, `cci`.`type` as `couponType`, `cfi`.`file_type`, `cfi`.`path`, case when `cci`.`type` = 3 then (select if(isnull(activation_deadline), if(`effective_days` = 0, null, date_format( date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d')), if(activation_deadline < date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'), activation_deadline, date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'))) from `special_package_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) else null end as `useDeadline`, date_format(`c`.`active_date`, '%Y-%m-%d') as `activeDate` from `card` `c` inner join `coupon_common_info` `cci` on `c`.`coupon_id` = `cci`.`id` left join `coupon_file_info` `cfi` on `cfi`.`coupon_id` = `cci`.`id` where `cci`.`is_inservice` = 1 and `c`.`status` in (2, 3, 4) and `c`.`patient_id` = #{patientId} and `cci`.`name` in ('014金藤卡礼包', '013银藤卡礼包', '012青藤卡礼包', '905 IVY 365 KIDS 2021版', '906 IVY 365卡 2021版', '907 IVY 1365卡 2021版','908 IVY 2365家庭卡 2021版') order by `cfi`.`id` desc ) `temp` where (isnull(`temp`.`useDeadline`) = 1 or `temp`.`useDeadline` >= date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-%d')) group by `temp`.`cardId`

select `temp`.`name` as couponName, `temp`.`couponType` as `couponType`, `temp`.`file_type` as fileType, `temp`.`path`, if(isnull(`temp`.`useDeadline`), '永久有效', concat_ws(' - ', `temp`.`activeDate`, `temp`.`useDeadline`)) as `effectiveDate` from ( select `c`.`id` as `cardId`, `cci`.`name`, `cci`.`type` as `couponType`, `cfi`.`file_type`, `cfi`.`path`, case when `cci`.`type` = 3 then (select if(isnull(activation_deadline), if(`effective_days` = 0, null, date_format( date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d')), if(activation_deadline < date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'), activation_deadline, date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'))) from `special_package_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) else null end as `useDeadline`, date_format(`c`.`active_date`, '%Y-%m-%d') as `activeDate` from `card` `c` inner join `coupon_common_info` `cci` on `c`.`coupon_id` = `cci`.`id` left join `coupon_file_info` `cfi` on `cfi`.`coupon_id` = `cci`.`id` where `cci`.`is_inservice` = 1 and `c`.`id` = #{cardId} order by `cfi`.`id` desc) `temp` group by `temp`.`cardId`
select `c`.`id` from `card` `c` where `c`.`patient_id` = #{patientId} or find_in_set( #{patientId}, `c`.`sharer`)

SELECT bc.active_org_id AS org_id, 7 AS eventCode, bc.active_date AS timePoint, bcp.name AS effectBody FROM card bc LEFT JOIN coupon_common_info bcp ON bc.coupon_id = bcp.id WHERE bc.STATUS > 1 AND bc.patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY bc.active_date ASC

select `c`.remark, `c`.`id` as `cardId`, `cci`.`id` as `couponId`, `cci`.`name` as `couponName`, `c`.`sold_target` as `soldTarget`, `c`.`buyer_id` as `buyerId`, `c`.`status` as `status`, `co`.`status` as `orderStatus`, `co`.`id` as `orderId`, case when `c`.`org_id` = 0 then `c`.`third_card_number` else `c`.`card_number` end as `cardNumber`, `cci`.`type` as `couponType`, `cci`.`product_type_id`, `cci`.`is_inservice` as `couponEnable`, `c`.`sale_channel_id`, case when `cci`.`type` = 2 then (select `use_way` from `package_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 3 then date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval `vc`.`effective_days` day), '%Y-%m-%d')), if(date_format(`vc`.`activation_deadline`, '%Y-%m-%d') > date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`vc`.`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'), date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`vc`.`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'), date_format(`vc`.`activation_deadline`, '%Y-%m-%d')))) from `vouche_coupon` `vc` where `vc`.`coupon_id` = `c`.coupon_id) when `cci`.`type` = 1 then (select if(isnull(`c`.`active_date`), null, if(isnull(`dc`.`activation_deadline`), if(`dc`.`effective_days` = 0, null, date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval `dc`.`effective_days` day), '%Y-%m-%d')), if(date_format(`dc`.`activation_deadline`, '%Y-%m-%d') > date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`dc`.`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'), date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`dc`.`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'), date_format(`dc`.`activation_deadline`, '%Y-%m-%d')))) from `discount_coupon` `dc` where `dc`.`coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 2 then (select if(isnull(`c`.`active_date`), null, if(isnull(`pc`.`activation_deadline`), if(`pc`.`effective_days` = 0, null, date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval `pc`.`effective_days` day), '%Y-%m-%d')), if(date_format(`pc`.`activation_deadline`, '%Y-%m-%d') > date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`pc`.`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'), date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`pc`.`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'), date_format(`pc`.`activation_deadline`, '%Y-%m-%d')))) from `package_coupon` `pc` where `pc`.`coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 5 then (select if(isnull(`c`.`active_date`), null, if(isnull(`spc`.`activation_deadline`), if(`spc`.`effective_days` = 0, null, date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval `spc`.`effective_days` day), '%Y-%m-%d')), if(date_format(`spc`.`activation_deadline`, '%Y-%m-%d') > date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`spc`.`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'), date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`spc`.`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'), date_format(`spc`.`activation_deadline`, '%Y-%m-%d')))) from `deduction_coupon` `spc` where `spc`.`coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) else null end as `useDeadline`, date_format(`c`.`active_date`, '%Y-%m-%d') as `activeDate`, case when `cci`.`type` = 0 then (select `is_share` from `vouche_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 1 then (select `is_share` from `discount_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 2 then (select `is_share` from `package_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 5 then (select `is_share` from `deduction_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) else null end as `share`, `c`.`patient_id` as `cardOwner`, `c`.`sharer` as `sharer` from `card` `c` inner join `coupon_common_info` `cci` on `c`.`coupon_id` = `cci`.`id` left join `coupon_order_virtual` `cor` on `cor`.`card_id` = `c`.`id` and cor.inservice = 1 left join `coupon_order` `co` on `co`.`id` = `cor`.`order_id` and `co`.status != 2 where `cci`.`type` = 5 and ((`c`.`status` in (1,2,3,4) and `c`.`sold_target` = #{query.patientId} and `cor`.inservice = 1) or (`c`.`status` in (2,3,4) and `c`.`patient_id` = #{query.patientId}))
and `cci`.`name` like concat('%', #{query.couponName}, '%')
order by `activeDate` desc
